profileEvidence.author: C
profileEvidence.summary: Courageous, energetic and intelligent, the Armant is devoted to its family and tends to reserve its welcome for strangers. This Egyptian herding dog also works as a guardian, combining an alert manner with a sustained, ground-covering trot. It developed in the Armant region of Upper Egypt.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Energetic and devoted, the Armant combines Egyptian herding and guarding work with a reserved response to strangers.
